name: Ancient woodland dataset
fact: 44,373 ancient woodlands; collector last ran 22 July 2026 and all data is from authoritative sources.
gate: Exact parcel intersection plus current standing advice is required; inventory absence does not prove no ancient woodland.

name: Ancient woodland status dataset
fact: Two statuses are published: ASNW and PAWS.
gate: Status classification is not a development decision or impact assessment.

name: SSSI dataset
fact: 4,128 SSSIs; collector last ran 20 July 2026 and newest data was found 23 April 2026.
gate: Designation geometry is a constraint screen; exact notified features and current Natural England advice are still required.

name: Special area of conservation dataset
fact: 260 SAC records; collector last ran 18 July 2026.
gate: Exact geometry and habitats-regulations assessment context are required; dataset membership is not automatic refusal.

name: Special protection area dataset
fact: 88 SPA records from Natural England; collector last ran 16 July 2026.
gate: Exact geometry and proposal-specific protected-site assessment remain required.

name: Ramsar dataset
fact: 73 Ramsar sites; collector last ran 21 July 2026.
gate: Ramsar designation is a planning constraint input, not a parcel-level permission outcome.

name: National nature reserve dataset
fact: 224 national nature reserves; collector last ran 23 July 2026 and new data was found 22 July 2026.
gate: Reserve geometry is environmental context; proposal-specific legal/planning effects require current evidence.

name: Local nature reserve dataset
fact: 1,727 local nature reserves from two providers; collector last ran 8 July 2026.
gate: Provider completeness and exact designation status must be checked before parcel use.

name: Scheduled monument dataset
fact: 20,150 scheduled monuments; collector and newest data both reached 22 July 2026.
gate: Scheduled monument geometry is a heritage constraint; works can require separate scheduled monument consent.

name: Listed building dataset
fact: 382,250 listed buildings; collector and newest data reached 21 July 2026; the dataset states its point does not define the full affected extent.
gate: Do not use listed-building points as exact curtilage or parcel boundaries.

name: Listed building outline dataset
fact: 121,057 outlines from 93 providers; work in progress with incomplete England coverage and inconsistent curtilage representation.
gate: Indicative outline cannot be treated as definitive listed-building curtilage.

name: Historic parks and gardens dataset
fact: 1,723 registered parks and gardens; collector last ran 20 July 2026 and newest data was found 18 July 2026.
gate: Exact registered boundary and proposal effects must be assessed; designation alone is not consent outcome.

name: Park and garden grade dataset
fact: Three grades are published: I, II and II*.
gate: Grade classification does not by itself determine planning outcome.

name: World heritage site dataset
fact: 40 World Heritage Sites; collector last ran 21 July 2026 and newest data was found 11 July 2026.
gate: World Heritage status is protected through the planning system; exact setting and buffer evidence is required.

name: World heritage buffer zone dataset
fact: 9 World Heritage Site buffer zones; collector last ran 20 July 2026.
gate: Buffer-zone implications require exact current site management and planning evidence.

name: Battlefield dataset
fact: 94 registered battlefields; all data is from authoritative sources and collector last ran 21 July 2026.
gate: Designation is a heritage constraint input, not automatic refusal.

name: Tree preservation order dataset
fact: 107,674 TPOs from 74 providers; collector and newest data reached 21 July 2026.
gate: Order record must be linked to current order document and exact protected tree or zone before applying parcel control.

name: Tree preservation zone dataset
fact: 94,023 tree-preservation zones from 79 providers; collector and newest data reached 22 July 2026.
gate: Zone geometry must be linked to the live order; provider coverage is not national completeness proof.

name: Tree dataset
fact: 247,862 tree records from 74 providers; collector and newest data reached 22 July 2026.
gate: Individual tree record requires current TPO linkage and proposal-specific arboricultural assessment.

name: Tree preservation zone type dataset
fact: Three zone types are published: area, group and woodland.
gate: Zone type is classification metadata, not exact legal coverage.

name: Locally listed building dataset
fact: 448 locally listed buildings; dataset is experimental and MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
gate: Do not promote experimental local-list data without current LPA list and exact asset relation.

name: National park dataset
fact: 10 national-park statistical boundaries; collector last ran 23 July 2026.
gate: ONS statistical boundary must not be treated as the complete planning-policy constraint without authority evidence.

name: National park authority dataset
fact: 10 national park authorities including the Broads are listed.
gate: Organisation routing does not itself establish policy or parcel status.

name: Tree preservation order specification
fact: Updated 10 April 2026; specification separates TPO legal instruments, protected zones and individual trees.
gate: Specification describes required data structure, not whether a TPO applies to a target parcel.

name: Listed building specification
fact: Specification requires structured listed-building data and an outline dataset.
gate: Specification is schema guidance, not exact current curtilage evidence.

name: Tree Preservation Orders PPG
fact: Government guidance explains LPAs can make TPOs where expedient in the interests of amenity.
gate: A TPO can constrain works but does not automatically prohibit development.

name: Planning applications affecting trees and woodland
fact: Forestry Commission says woodland can be a material planning consideration and it is a non-statutory consultee for development affecting or within 500m of ancient woodland.
gate: Consultation trigger is not a parcel-level refusal or permission result.

name: Ancient woodland planning decisions standing advice
fact: Standing advice treats ancient woodland and ancient/veteran trees as irreplaceable habitats and requires impact assessment.
gate: Inventory geometry is a screen; smaller or newly evidenced ancient woodland can be absent from inventories.

name: Keepers of time policy
fact: Government policy restates protection and improvement objectives for ancient/native woodland and ancient/veteran trees.
gate: Policy context is not project-specific evidence.

name: Trees and woodland guidance for local authorities
fact: Published 14 February 2026; current guidance groups planning, protection, management and funding resources for trees and woodland.
gate: Resource availability does not establish site consent or funding.
